name: Si7021 temperature & humidity sensor
description: Silicon Labs Si7021-A20 digital relative humidity (0–100 %, ±3 % typical) and temperature (-40 to 125 °C, ±0.4 °C typical) sensor with an I2C interface at fixed address 0x40; the chip itself runs on 1.9–3.6 V. Sold as: GY-21 Si7021 temperature & humidity module (4-pin header VIN, GND, SCL, SDA; on-board 3.3 V regulator and MOSFET level shifting, so VIN takes 3.3–5 V).
eli5: Tells your board how warm the air is and how damp it is.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Module supply, 3.3–5 V (on-board regulator feeds the chip 3.3 V)

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (level-shifted, pull-up on the module)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (level-shifted, pull-up on the module)

supplierQuery: GY-21 Si7021 temperature humidity sensor module I2C
buildNotes: Power VIN from the same voltage as your board's logic (3.3 V on ESP32/Pico); the module's regulator and level shifters handle 5 V boards too.

No-hold measurement: write 0xF5 (humidity, wait about 25 ms because it also measures temperature) or 0xF3 (temperature, wait 11 ms), then read 3 bytes: MSB, LSB, CRC. The chip NACKs its address until the conversion is done.
After a humidity measurement, command 0xE0 returns the temperature taken during it (2 bytes, no CRC), saving a second conversion.
Check the CRC (poly 0x31, init 0x00). Convert the 16-bit word as returned: T = 175.72*code/65536 - 46.85, RH = 125*code/65536 - 6 (clamp RH to 0–100).
The address is fixed at 0x40 (shared with HTU21D/SHT21/INA219 defaults), so only one per I2C bus without a multiplexer.
Keep the sensor away from the regulator and the microcontroller, which warm the air nearby.

driver.code:
# Si7021-A20 temperature & humidity sensor (Silicon Labs), MicroPython driver.
# Uses the "No Hold Master" commands (0xF5 humidity, 0xF3 temperature) at the default
# 12-bit RH / 14-bit T resolution, reads the temperature measured during the RH
# conversion with 0xE0, and checks the CRC-8 (x^8+x^5+x^4+1 = 0x31, init 0x00).
import time

_ADDR = 0x40
_MEAS_RH_NOHOLD = 0xF5
_MEAS_T_NOHOLD = 0xF3
_READ_PREV_T = 0xE0
_RESET = 0xFE


def _crc8(data):
    crc = 0x00
    for b in data:
        crc ^= b
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x31) & 0xFF if crc & 0x80 else (crc << 1) & 0xFF
    return crc


def _t_from_code(code):
    return 175.72 * code / 65536 - 46.85


class SI7021:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=_ADDR):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        time.sleep_ms(80)  # power-up: up to 80 ms over the full temperature range
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes([_RESET]))
        time.sleep_ms(15)  # reset takes up to 15 ms

    def _measure(self, cmd, wait_ms):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes([cmd]))
        time.sleep_ms(wait_ms)  # datasheet maximum conversion time
        d = None
        for _ in range(10):  # the chip NACKs its address until the conversion is done
            try:
                d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 3)
                break
            except OSError:
                time.sleep_ms(5)
        if d is None:
            raise OSError('Si7021 not responding: check the wiring')
        if _crc8(d[0:2]) != d[2]:
            raise OSError('Si7021 CRC mismatch: check the wiring')
        return (d[0] << 8) | d[1]

    def humidity(self):
        """Relative humidity in %: 125 * RH_Code / 65536 - 6, limited to 0..100."""
        # 12-bit RH (12 ms) plus the 14-bit temperature it also measures (10.8 ms)
        rh = 125 * self._measure(_MEAS_RH_NOHOLD, 25) / 65536 - 6
        return min(100.0, max(0.0, rh))

    def temperature(self):
        """Temperature in °C: 175.72 * Temp_Code / 65536 - 46.85."""
        return _t_from_code(self._measure(_MEAS_T_NOHOLD, 11))

    def read(self):
        """Measure humidity, then fetch the temperature taken during that measurement (0xE0).
        Returns (temperature in °C, relative humidity in %)."""
        h = self.humidity()
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes([_READ_PREV_T]))
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 2)  # 0xE0 returns no checksum
        return _t_from_code((d[0] << 8) | d[1]), h

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from si7021 import SI7021

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = SI7021(i2c)
while True:
    t, h = sensor.read()
    print('T=%.1fC H=%.1f%%' % (t, h))
    time.sleep(1)
